name: Bound to Place — Tag
notes: The being's nature and power are tied to a specific natural seat.

name: Bound to Place — Trait
traitDescription: It is tied to a natural seat such as a grove, spring, stone, marsh, or cliff, and is strongest when acting through or within that place.
notes: Core identity trait for Nature Spirits.

name: Warden of a Natural Seat — Tag
notes: Reacts to trespass, damage, theft, pollution, and broken respect within its place.

name: Warden of a Natural Seat — Trait
traitDescription: It notices and reacts when its place is violated, neglected, polluted, despoiled, or treated without proper respect, and may answer respect with aid or trespass with warning, misdirection, or death.
notes: Core reciprocity and guardianship rule for Nature Spirits.

name: More Than Landscape — Tag
notes: The being is part of the place, but not merely scenery.

name: More Than Landscape — Trait
traitDescription: It can seem beautiful, monstrous, half-seen, or wholly natural until it chooses to reveal that the place itself is watching.
notes: Tone-setting trait for local uncanny presence.

name: Grant: Call of the Place
notes: Grants the Call of the Place power.

name: Grant: Grasp of Root and Stone
notes: Grants the Grasp of Root and Stone power.

name: Grant: Slip Into the Land
notes: Grants the Slip Into the Land power.

name: Grant: Blessing of the Place
notes: Grants the (optional) Blessing of the Place power.

name: Natural Creature — Tag
notes: The being is a natural animal, not an inherently supernatural entity.

name: Natural Creature — Trait
traitDescription: This is a living animal shaped by body, instinct, and environment rather than by glamour, curse, or mythic office.

name: Keen Senses — Tag
notes: The animal notices scent, sound, movement, and weakness quickly.

name: Keen Senses — Trait
traitDescription: It relies on scent, hearing, movement, and instinctive awareness to track danger, prey, or intrusion.
notes: Core perception and pursuit trait for Beasts.

name: Tooth and Claw — Tag
notes: The creature's body is itself a weapon.

name: Tooth and Claw — Trait
traitDescription: It attacks with bite, claw, horn, tusk, trampling force, or other natural weaponry rather than crafted arms.
